title: Embolist
extract:
The Embolist fires a toxic stream of poison with a high chance to proc  Toxin.
This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Characteristics
This weapon deals only  Toxin damage.
Damage ramps up from 45% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 45% over 2 seconds.
The zone of impact or maximum beam range produces a spherical blast radius of 1 meter, allowing it to hit multiple enemies at once.
The radial damage is not affected by multishot.
The radius is affected by ( Primed)  Fulmination.
 Magnum Force's accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
Can use the Embolist-exclusive mods  Eroding Blight and  Vile Discharge.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Secondary Held Pistol weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Pinpoint accuracy.
Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average damage per shot (35.52)
High total damage (35)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high accuracy (0.00° to 0.00°)
Very high reload speed (1.30 s)
High status chance (41.00%)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.40x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary Held Pistol weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Limited range of 9 meters.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (3.00%)
Below average burst DPS (284.2)
Very low magazine size (33)
Below average ammo max (210)
Very low fire rate (8.00 attacks/sec)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Embolist's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Notes
The projectile creates a toxin cloud on whatever surface it hits, this is purely cosmetic and does no additional damage, staying for less than a second.

Tips
As the Embolist is primarily a close range weapon that benefits from area of effect,  Magnum Force can be beneficial in increasing both its damage and its spread.
 Ruinous Extension will increase the range of the weapon by almost double (from a max range of 9m to 17m).
Multishot affects the beam but not the small radial damage effect where the beam ends.
Punch Through can be slotted but has no effect on the weapon.

Trivia
An embolism refers to the lodging of an embolus, such as a blood clot or gas bubble. It can cause a circulatory blockage which affects a different part of the body away from the actual site of the blockage.
The visual effect of the Embolist resembles the special attack of the Nauseous Crawler, indicating that this weapon may be a part of said Infested or derived from it. However, apart from the similar attack appearance there are no shared properties.
The 'tail' on this weapon moves.
Interestingly, the weapon's reload animation seems to involve pulling (or possibly twisting) the weapon's tail.
Originally the weapon behaved exactly like the Ignis, having infinite body punch through and having the rare effect of proccing toxin on every hit even if the weapon's toxin was changed to a new element. Both of these mechanics were entirely removed for unknown reasons.

Known Bugs
When given to a Rescue target, the cloud released when fired will be the Embolist's default energy color, as opposed to the customized one shown on the weapon itself.
 Galvanized Shot is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from alt-fire if using  Vile Discharge.
